steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Less than 30 meters. Can't see the bottom yet... The crypt is deeper than I thought.
In the bottomless darkness beneath, the invisible evil presence is still throbbing and spitting murmurs of malice.

options: There could be enemies down there—Corruptors or monsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I get it... I get it! Look, I've got goose bumps all over. I'm not blind or deaf. I know nothing good is going on down there.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Since this place has something to do with Par... with Mania Crystals, it'll surprise no one if there are some demons or monsters lurking down there.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Brace yourself. There's gonna be an ugly battle the second we land.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Looks like... we don't have to wait. They're already here.

Without any warning, the elevator slams into some obstacle. Following a loud bang, the elevator crashes through something hard—a random array of crystals, perhaps, which are falling into pieces upon impact.
You can't see the bottom. The only sensation you are experiencing is the jerky descent of the elevator, which eventually gets stuck at an angle somewhere in the middle.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Not yet. But careful... We're trapped in the center of the contamination.
A faint light illuminates the deep shaft, whose walls are covered with huge contaminated spikes. It's these spikes that have brought the elevator to a halt.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What's that sound? There's something crawling in between the spikes...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It can't be. We took care of them long ago. This is something else!
